items.title: Multi-language
items.body: Full French, English, and Arabic support (including RTL), with localized battle messages, lobby, deck builder, and legal copy.

items.title: Replays
items.body: Matches can be replayed: animation directives and match state are stored so you can review a fight afterward.

items.title: Bot opponents
items.body: If you stay alone in queue, a bot can join you. Bots have personalities (setup, control, finisher), simulate actions, and improve through replay-based training.

items.title: Sandbox & Animation Lab
items.body: New sandbox space to test game scenarios, with a config drawer and an Animation Lab tab to preview effects.

items.title: Ladder
items.body: Added ELO decay for ranked standings so ratings better reflect recent activity.

items.title: Card animations
items.body: Large 3D animation wave: D-Strike Attack, Flare Blinder, Barrage d'Eau, Mirage Aquatique, Destruction Meteor Storm, Coup de Grâce, Dual Gazer, Visage de la Fureur, plus many elemental abilities (Pyrus, Aquos, Haos, Subterra, Ventus, Darkus) with new effects (meteors, tornados, impacts, auras, scene illumination).

items.title: Rules & protections
items.body: Reworked power-change handling, stronger protection mechanics, and card adjustments (Barrage d'Eau, Dual Gazer, traps, exclusive abilities).

items.title: Deck builder
items.body: Stricter, clearer deck validation: validity badges, detailed error messages, and a clearer split between deck composition and in-match usable resources.

items.title: Tutorial
items.body: Tutorial rewritten: Turn 0, battle initiative order, board cleanup / Clear Domain, gate types (reactor, Character, Command, traps), exclusive and persistent abilities.

items.title: 3D board
items.body: Improved tooltips and mesh user data, plus polish on gate opens and Bakugan returns.

items.title: Matchmaking
items.body: Better bot/human integration, shorter solo wait, and fixes around rooms and match start.

items.title: Evolved Bakugans
items.body: Added evolved Bakugans and fusion abilities to expand late-game strategies.

items.title: Attribute change
items.body: Players can now change a Bakugan's attribute in battle, with a dedicated animation and updated power levels.

items.title: Tutorial
items.body: Added an in-game tutorial page with help content and external links for new players.

items.title: Ability cards & Gate Building
items.body: Improved several ability card effects and fixed Gate Building slot selection and animations.

items.title: Balance
items.body: Buffed Backdraft.

items.title: Spectators
items.body: Matches now support spectators, including rooms where you are watching a game.

items.title: Deck import / export
items.body: Decks can be shared through encode and decode import/export.

items.title: Lock Down
items.body: Added the Lock Down Gate Card.

items.title: Gate cards
items.body: Improved gate card activation logic, including auto-battle checks when two Bakugans are present.

items.title: Match viewer
items.body: Fixed issues with the match viewer.

items.title: New trap cards
items.body: Added new trap Gate Cards, including Mine Ghost.

items.title: New abilities
items.body: Added Heat Wave, Cadenas and other ability/command cards.

items.title: Activation logic
items.body: Refined ability activation conditions and usable-card checks.

items.title: New Bakugans
items.body: Added the Tuskor and Manion families with their abilities.

items.title: Cancelable abilities
items.body: Expanded cancelable ability support and related card management.

items.title: Global chat
items.body: Added a global chat with message handling across the lobby.

items.title: Ladder status
items.body: Players now show online/offline connection indicators on the ladder.

items.title: Balance
items.body: Nerfed Deep Sea Dive and clarified its description.

items.title: Discord
items.body: Added a Discord link with logo in the layout.

items.title: Bee Striker
items.body: Added Ventus Bee Striker and its abilities. Fear Reaper was renamed Fear Ripper.

items.title: Protection effects
items.body: Added ability-block / protection support. Fire Wall now protects against abilities, and Guardian Field was added for Juggernoid.

items.title: Life Drew
items.body: Added the Life Drew ability card. Existing abilities now better respect protection status.

items.title: Gate nullifiers
items.body: Added gate nullifier abilities, updated Cut in Saber, and refreshed gate card visuals on the field.

items.title: Balance & fixes
items.body: Adjusted Limulus power (350 → 310), prevented Tsunami from being used during battles, and fixed inactive-player actions after opening a gate card.

items.title: New Bakugans
items.body: Added Limulus and Robotallion with updated abilities.

items.title: Deck checker
items.body: Added a frontend deck checker and fixed meta deck validation.

items.title: Combat fixes
items.body: Fixed draw battles, duplicate Bakugans, Anthemusa, Gravity Chamber, Grand Spirit canceling, and Fire Tornado turn-interface issues.

items.title: Feedback
items.body: Improved game-finished checks and power-change number animations.

items.title: Forfeit
items.body: Players can now forfeit a match. Watch Battle gained a name search bar and a rooms list at battle end.

items.title: Tooltips
items.body: Added Tippy tooltips when hovering Bakugans, gate cards and turn actions on the 3D board.

items.title: Subterra abilities
items.body: Added Tectonic Swipe, Earth Power, Sand Trap and Spirit Hole.

items.title: In-game chat
items.body: Redesigned the in-game messages window and allowed sending messages during a match.

items.title: Rooms & matchmaking
items.body: Timers now start when a room is created, rooms are cleaned up automatically, and matchmaking/challenge flow was improved.

items.title: Bug fixes
items.body: Fixed drag abilities, Tsunami Wave, Fury of Wind, Mantris Marionette, dead Bakugans remaining in hand, and Tentaclear balance.

items.title: Chat system
items.body: Added a global find-user chat, online player checks, connected-user stores, and mobile message layout fixes.

items.title: Challenges
items.body: Players can challenge others from the chat window, and challenges can be canceled or rejected.

items.title: Matchmaking
items.body: Refactored the matchmaking system and unified socket listeners.

items.title: Elo & ladder
items.body: Added the Elo system and a ladder page to track rankings.

items.title: Watch matches
items.body: Added match spectating with a dedicated 3D viewer page.

items.title: Persistent abilities
items.body: Introduced persistent abilities. Boosted Dragon (Pyrus Drago) now works as a persistent ability.

items.title: Board UI
items.body: Polished the 3D board background, selectors, power text size and hover descriptions.

items.title: Balance
items.body: Updated several card conditions and nerfed Face of Grief.

items.title: New ability cards
items.body: Added Flare Blinder, Mega Flare Blinder and Super Pyrus, plus a power swipe helper.

items.title: Magma Fuse
items.body: Added the Magma Fuse Gate Card with a revive Bakugan animation.

items.title: Card updates
items.body: Gravity Chamber and Anthemusa now drag weaker Bakugans and eliminate them. Dragoon and Shield Merge moved to exclusive abilities.

items.title: Turn requests
items.body: Fixed turn action requests after setting a gate card and when clearing domain forms.

items.title: Battle music
items.body: Added an OST player during battles with a volume controller.

items.title: Cancel abilities
items.body: Added cancel-ability animations, ability-block properties and Haos counter updates.

items.title: New cards
items.body: Added Tsunami Wave and Fury of Wind. Elemental and character cards now add/remove boosts when Bakugans move or are set.

items.title: Board animations
items.body: Added remove-reinforcement, move-gate and swipe-gate animations.

items.title: Messages UI
items.body: Cleaned up the match messages window design.

items.title: Game messages
items.body: Added a game message window and a rooms list on the dashboard.

items.title: Turn system
items.body: Refactored and unified turn action resolution and the turn interface.

items.title: UI fixes
items.body: Increased z-index for dialog boxes and turn action buttons on the 3D board.

items.title: Balance
items.body: Updated Bakugan power levels and the Centipod Attractor ability.

items.title: Battle timer
items.body: Added a game timer (except on the first gate card selection turn). The timer now correctly stops when a game ends.

items.title: Ability conditions
items.body: Abilities now use activation conditions and a can-use parameter. Failed activations show a dedicated animation.

items.title: Ability counter
items.body: Added an ability counter to battles.

items.title: Rooms list
items.body: Unified battle-start socket listeners and added a rooms list on the dashboard.

items.title: Card translation
items.body: All remaining French cards have been translated into English.

items.title: Deck Builder
items.body: Fixed a bug preventing players from creating multiple decks. The Deck Builder is now fully responsive on mobile.

items.title: Mantris Marionette
items.body: Resolved turn-related issues when using the Mantris Marionette card.

items.title: Phantom turn
items.body: Players who cannot act no longer see a full action interface; they are simply prompted to end their turn.

items.title: Landing & dashboard
items.body: Fixed multiple integration issues on the landing page and dashboard.

items.title: Discord
items.body: Added a direct link to the official Discord server on the landing page.

items.title: 3D controls
items.body: Fixed mouse and touch controls on the 3D gameboard.
